程序包 org.springframework.batch.core.step.tasklet

类 TestingChunkOrientedTasklet<T>

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.batch.core.step.item.ChunkOrientedTasklet<T>
org.springframework.batch.core.step.tasklet.TestingChunkOrientedTasklet<T>
所有已实现的接口:
Tasklet
public class TestingChunkOrientedTasklet<T> extends ChunkOrientedTasklet<T>
Simplest possible implementation of Tasklet with no skipping or recovering or processing. Just delegates all calls to the provided ItemReader and ItemWriter.
